name: Uply — Scroll to Top, Progress Bar & Read Time
author: sumuraka

sections.description:
Uply is designed to solve one major problem: Reader Fatigue. Long articles can be overwhelming, but with the right visual cues, you can keep users engaged and navigating effortlessly. This plugin brings together three essential tools — Scroll to Top, Progress Bar, and Reading Time — all optimized for speed and SEO.

1. Advanced WordPress Scroll to Top Button

Make it easy for your visitors to return to the top of your page with a single click. No more manual scrolling through long-form content.

  • Classic Icon Library: Access a selection of clean, professional icons like Arrows, Chevrons, and Circles that fit any website style.
  • Flexible Alignment: Position your button on the Left or Right side of the screen with adjustable bottom margins to avoid overlapping other elements.
  • 70+ Massive Template Library (PRO): Upgrade to a huge collection of creative designs, including Rocket icons, Paper planes, and 3D animated buttons.
  • Scroll-Progress Buttons (PRO): A high-end feature where the button itself acts as a progress bar, filling up as the user scrolls down.
  • Custom SVG Icon Builder: Total creative freedom. Use unique SVG icons and manually customize the background, borders, and hover effects.
  • Mobile Visibility Control: Keep your mobile UI clean by choosing to specifically enable or disable the button on mobile devices.

2. Dynamic Reading Progress Bar

A progress bar provides a visual “roadmap” for your readers, giving them a sense of accomplishment as they move through your content.

  • Sleek Minimalist Styles: Start with clean Solid, Segmented, or Rainbow colored bars that stick to the top of the viewport.
  • Top Positioning: A standard, non-intrusive bar that tracks reading progress in real-time.
  • 40+ Premium Visual Effects (PRO): Transform your progress bar with eye-catching animations like Neon Glow, Liquid Metal, Gradient Waves, and Glitch effects.
  • Bottom Viewport Toggle: Flexibility to move the progress bar to the bottom of the screen based on your site’s design needs.
  • Height & Thickness Control: Use a precision range slider to adjust the thickness (in pixels) of the bar to make it as subtle or bold as you want.
  • Intelligent Sticky Offset: Automatically add “Space Above or Below” to ensure the bar never hides behind your sticky header or footer.

3. Smart Reading Time Indicator

Build transparency and trust. By showing readers how long a post will take, you improve the chances of them starting—and finishing—the article.

  • Accurate WPM Algorithm: Uses a smart “Words Per Minute” calculation to provide a realistic time estimate for any post or page.
  • Simple Text Layout: Display a clean “X minutes read” label automatically before your content.
  • 15+ Designer Icon Layouts (Pro): Choose from professional horizontal layouts that include Clock, Book, or Hourglass icons.
  • Dual-Positioning: Choose to display the reading time Before Content, After Content, or in both locations for maximum visibility.
  • Full Typography Suite: Complete control over the look and feel. Customize the font size, text colors, background colors, padding, and margins without touching a line of code.
  • Custom Prefix & Postfix: Change the default labels to anything you want (e.g., “Estimate:” or “Minutes to finish”).

4. Intelligent Targeting & Performance

Uply is built for power users who want control over where and how these features appear without sacrificing site speed.

  • Vanilla CSS Power: All animations are built with optimized CSS. This means zero impact on Core Web Vitals and no heavy JavaScript libraries like jQuery or GSAP.
  • Global Enable/Disable: One-click control to turn features on or off site-wide.
  • Conditional Display Logic: Target your features specifically. Choose to enable or disable tools for specific Post Types (e.g., show on Posts but hide on Pages).
  • Precise Page Exclusion: Use the built-in search interface to exclude specific Page IDs or posts where you don’t want the features to appear.

Why Choose Uply?

Whether you use the feature-packed Free version or the designer-grade PRO version, Uply is engineered to improve your “Time on Site” and “Bounce Rate”—two of the most important metrics for SEO and user satisfaction.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/uply-scroll-to-top-and-progress-bar directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Uply menu in the dashboard to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Can I hide the Scroll to Top button on mobile?

Yes, there is a setting to toggle visibility on mobile devices.

How is the read time calculated?

It is based on the word count of the post content divided by the reading speed (default 200 words per minute), which you can customize.
